questions.question: In a vision of the end, where did an angel throw the dragon, the ancient serpent, for a thousand years?
In a vision of the end, what happens to those beheaded for their testimony of Jesus who refused to worship the beast?

answers.text: They come to life and reign with Christ
They rest under the altar a while longer
They stand guard over the sealed Abyss

questions.question: When Satan's huge army surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city, what happened to that army?

answers.text: Fire came down from heaven and consumed them
The saints marched out and drove them away
They turned around and ran back home
